en: Fixed `claude agents` and `claude rm` refusing to remove a fully pushed session ("The worktree has unpushed commits") when its worktree has a file or folder named `HEAD` at the top level
zh: 修复了当 session 的 worktree 顶层存在名为 `HEAD` 的文件或文件夹时，`claude agents` 和 `claude rm` 拒绝移除已完全推送的 session（提示 "The worktree has unpushed commits"）的问题
